_comment: Large detached garage behind 25 East Main St at the Temple St corner, west of the house. White clapboard, sea-green standing-seam metal hip roof, ridge along u. Driveway comes down from East Main to the +u (NNE) end, which has one wide dark-green glazed door; -u (SSW, pool side) has a big multi-pane window at the left; -v (WNW, parking-lot side) has two small windows; +v (toward the house) is hidden behind the hedge and left plain.
